name: Dr. Khalid Al-Otaibi
title: Consultant Family Physician
bio: Dr. Khalid leads family care at the Al-Malqa branch. He focuses on long-term conditions such as diabetes and high blood pressure, and on keeping routine check-ups simple for busy families.
education: Fellowship in Chronic Disease Management, Toronto

name: Dr. Noura Al-Qahtani
title: Family Medicine Specialist
bio: Dr. Noura treats patients of every age, with a special interest in women's health and preventive screening.

name: Dr. Faisal Al-Dosari
title: Consultant Family Physician
bio: Dr. Faisal sees adults and teenagers for everyday illness, vaccinations and annual health reviews.

name: Dr. Hanan Bakr
title: Family Medicine Specialist
bio: Dr. Hanan has worked in Jeddah for nine years and runs the weight and nutrition follow-up programme at the branch.

name: Dr. Abdullah Al-Mutairi
title: Family Medicine Specialist
bio: Dr. Abdullah provides primary care for families in Dammam and coordinates referrals to the other clinics in the group.
education: MBBS, Imam Abdulrahman bin Faisal University

name: Dr. Sara Al-Shehri
title: Consultant Pediatrician
bio: Dr. Sara has cared for newborns and young children for fifteen years. She runs the vaccination and growth-monitoring service at Al-Malqa.

name: Dr. Omar Hamdan
title: Pediatric Specialist
bio: Dr. Omar treats childhood asthma, allergies and recurrent infections.

name: Dr. Maha Al-Zahrani
title: Consultant Pediatrician
bio: Dr. Maha follows children from birth to adolescence and gives parents clear, practical advice on feeding and sleep.

name: Dr. Yousef Al-Ghamdi
title: Pediatric Specialist
bio: Dr. Yousef is the pediatrician at the Al-Rawdah branch and leads the school-age health check programme.

name: Dr. Lama Al-Harthi
title: Consultant Dermatologist
bio: Dr. Lama treats acne, eczema and pigmentation, and performs laser procedures at the Al-Malqa clinic.

name: Dr. Tariq Nasser
title: Dermatology Specialist
bio: Dr. Tariq has a special interest in hair and scalp conditions and in skin checks for adults.

name: Dr. Rania Fouad
title: Dermatology Specialist
bio: Dr. Rania treats common skin conditions in adults and children and offers a monthly skin-check day.

name: Dr. Saud Al-Anazi
title: Consultant Dermatologist
bio: Dr. Saud has sixteen years of experience in medical and cosmetic dermatology and trains junior doctors in the group.

name: Dr. Dalal Al-Subaie
title: Consultant Dentist
bio: Dr. Dalal leads the dental team at Al-Malqa. She focuses on restorative treatment and on making first visits calm for nervous patients.

name: Dr. Majed Al-Rashid
title: Orthodontist
bio: Dr. Majed fits braces and clear aligners for teenagers and adults.

name: Dr. Ahmed Kamal
title: Dental Specialist
bio: Dr. Ahmed provides fillings, root canal treatment and routine cleaning at the Al-Nakheel branch.

name: Dr. Reem Al-Juhani
title: Dental Specialist
bio: Dr. Reem is the general dentist for the Dammam branch and sees both adults and children.
education: BDS, Imam Abdulrahman bin Faisal University

name: Dr. Waleed Al-Sudairi
title: Consultant Cardiologist
bio: Dr. Waleed has eighteen years of experience in heart disease prevention and echocardiography. He heads the cardiology service for the group.

name: Dr. Huda Al-Jabri
title: Cardiology Specialist
bio: Dr. Huda follows patients with high blood pressure and rhythm problems, and runs the cardiac rehabilitation sessions.

name: Dr. Basem Idris
title: Consultant Cardiologist
bio: Dr. Basem sees patients in Jeddah for chest pain, palpitations and heart check-ups before surgery.

name: Dr. Nasser Al-Khaldi
title: Consultant Orthopedic Surgeon
bio: Dr. Nasser treats knee and hip problems and plans joint replacement for patients who need it.

name: Dr. Amal Al-Tamimi
title: Orthopedic Specialist
bio: Dr. Amal treats fractures, shoulder pain and sports injuries and guides patients through physiotherapy.

name: Dr. Ibrahim Al-Shammari
title: Orthopedic Specialist
bio: Dr. Ibrahim is the orthopedic specialist in Dammam, with a focus on spine and back pain.

name: Dr. Layla Al-Mansour
title: Sports Medicine Consultant
bio: Dr. Layla treats athletes and active adults, from muscle strains to ligament injuries, and designs recovery plans.
